contexts.text: He called the name thereof Jehovah Nissi () = the continual war and protection of the Lord against those who are in the falsity of interior evil... Jehovah Nissi, in the Original Language, means Jehovah my standard, or banner; and by a banner or standard, in the Word, is signified a convocation to war; and, as it is said the war of Jehovah, protection by Him is also signified. Illustrated.
